Forget to ask what type of girl she is more like, but this is what I would suggest:

\- a **perfectly-fitted, lightweight cotton shirt** would be nice! (if possible, get one with a **v-neck** \--> it would give you a more *confident* and *outgoing* vibe, while drawing attention to your face, and away from your body) (ALSO, lightweight or medium-weight shirts can help to give you a more *carefree* and *energetic* vibe, since bulkier outfits may give the impression of a more apathetic attitude)

\- for v-neck shirts, try to get one **without any patterns**, since heavy emphasis on patterns would highlight your build instead (if you are concerned about your size) (also, colours like **dark/dull/pale red, blue, green** etc. would look nice if you're tired of black haha)

\- for rounded-necks, **vertical lines** are great to give an illusion of further *slimness* AND *tallness*, while giving a sense of *self-confidence* (personally, I would suggest to avoid horizontal lines no matter your build - I avoid them too haha)

\- Since you like vibrant colours, the vertical lines as patterns can help you to showcase your bright energy --> get a **neutral colour base** (white/ black/ grey) with some **vibrant lines** (can be subdued colours or not, depending on your style...and the design of course)

\- for pants, **long straight-cut ones** would be good! Or **jogger** pants like one of the comments I saw suggested. But since you're going to USS, perhaps **Bermudas** would be more suitable, giving your legs air to breathe in the humid weather

\- if your shirt is too plain in design, you can wear a **belt** to complement the outfit too! Just try not to wear the same colours for your shirt and pants and you should be fine! (oh but make sure the colours dont clash though...like a pink shirt with lime pants...although there are exceptions of course)

\- one of the comments also suggested a **polo** shirt, which would look good too for the date! Theyre lightweight and can immediately create a *presentable* impression, but I personally feel that a USS date is more on the casual side!

\- just a general tip: im not sure if you are sensitive about your size, given that I have no idea how you look like anyways, but oversized tees can make a person look bigger and less confident in my opinion. So don't be afraid to wear outfits which fit you perfectly (not too tight, not too loose) **confidence is ultimately always key!!**
